T: Welcome to the family. Dinner's on.
D: The Byrnes family travel to Florida to meet the Focker parents before the wedding.
P: Serve the mains when the two families sit down together.
S: Crumbed ham croquettes with a creamy centre. Make a thick béchamel with 60g butter, 80g flour and 500ml milk, stir in 200g ham and chill.
Cheese fondue with bread, the Focker welcome. Heat 300ml white wine, stir in 400g gruyère tossed in cornflour until smooth.
M: the two families at the table
Mojo roast pork with black beans and rice, a Florida family feast. Marinate 1.5kg pork shoulder in orange, lime, garlic and cumin and roast at 160C for 3 hours.
W: Tangy key lime pie with a biscuit base and cream. Press 200g crushed biscuits and 80g butter into a dish.
K: White rum, lime, mint and soda. Virgin for the kids.

s.how: Make a thick béchamel with 60g butter, 80g flour and 500ml milk, stir in 200g ham and chill. Shape, crumb and fry at 180C. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Heat 300ml white wine, stir in 400g gruyère tossed in cornflour until smooth. Serve with bread cubes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: the two families at the table
m.how: Marinate 1.5kg pork shoulder in orange, lime, garlic and cumin and roast at 160C for 3 hours. Serve with black beans and 300g rice. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Press 200g crushed biscuits and 80g butter into a dish. Whisk 395g condensed milk, 4 yolks and 120ml lime juice, pour in and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Chill and top with cream.

d.how: Muddle mint and lime with sugar, add 45ml white rum and ice, top with soda. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
